280507417.description:
Product Overview:
This framed oil painting features an elderly man with a long white beard, wearing a woven straw hat and holding a smoking pipe. The artwork is rendered in a realistic style with visible brush strokes and a soft, muted color palette.

Specifications:
- Medium: Oil on canvas
- Subject: Elderly man with straw hat and smoking pipe
- Style: Realistic with visible brush strokes
- Color Palette: Soft, muted tones
- Frame: Bamboo-style wooden frame with textured brown mat
- Backing: Black paper with hanging wire
- Dimensions: 23.5 x 19.5 inches including frame

Additional Details:
The frame exhibits a rustic, vintage appearance. There are no visible artist signatures or identifying marks on the front.

280106511.description:
Product Overview:
This collection consists of various polished and raw petrified wood and agate specimens. The assortment includes slices and chunks with visible grain and bark patterns, as well as translucent agate pieces in cream, amber, and brown hues. The specimens exhibit both smooth polished and rough natural textures.

Specifications:
- Material: Petrified wood and agate
- Types: Polished and raw pieces
- Colors: Cream, amber, brown, and natural wood tones
- Texture: Smooth polished and rough natural
- Condition: Unbroken pieces without manufacturer markings

Diverse color palette including purple, pink, and earthy red tones
Raw, unpolished surfaces highlighting natural mineral formation
